metadata.description:
EON Studios Swing — 16-pad drum sampler for REAPER.
Includes the Swing JSFX, the Kit Bridge companion script, the sample browser, and the factory kit library (11 Vintage Synth kits built on the per-pad drum-synth engine, plus two sampled 808 kits).
ReaImGui is required for the sample browser — install separately from cfillion's repository.

16-pad drum sampler for REAPER with multi-out routing, kit save/load (.swing format), per-pad ADSR/FX/colors, a per-pad drum-synth engine, an integrated sample browser, and a factory kit library.
After install, restart REAPER. The Swing Kit Bridge auto-registers as a startup action on first run; manually launch it once from the Action List ("Swing_Kit_Bridge.lua") to set up auto-start.
Requires ReaImGui for the sample browser (install separately via cfillion's repository).

version.author: EON Studios
version.changelog:
Swing 3.0 — the largest release since launch. Project format advances from ser_ver 44 to 52; 2.1.x projects and kits load forward cleanly.
- Per-pad DRUM SYNTH: nine engine families, thirty voice types, playable alongside (or instead of) samples on any pad, with its own Big View editor. - Eleven Vintage Synth factory kits built entirely on that engine — no samples, no licensing, and they load instantly. - BIG VIEW workspace over the pad grid: piano-roll note mapping with layout modes and an editable choke lane, a per-pad colour board, an output routing matrix, and a kit browser. - MULTI-INSTANCE: every Swing in a project is its own instrument, with independent pitch, mute/solo, colours and names. - Rebuilt EQ (zero-zipper state-variable filter, fourth band) and a rebuilt pitch engine (pitch-preserved Tuned bake, instant tune, élastique Stretch). - Drag samples straight from the browser onto pads — including onto Swing embedded in the track or mixer panel. - EON Drum Strip channel strip, multi-out FX returns, per-pad FX panel. - Step Sequencer and Drum Matrix: groove import/export, role-first preset browser, live two-way sync, song mode. - Internal undo engine, so REAPER's Ctrl+Z can no longer wipe a kit. - Keybindable action catalogue, EON command menus, and a song-starter action that lays out tempo, regions, a Swing track and its drum lanes in one go. - Kit cover artwork: drag an image onto the KIT tab and it travels inside the .swing file. All thirteen factory kits ship with machine-portrait covers; coverless kits draw a matching vector portrait. - Choppa exports slices as WAVs; the KIT tab gained a NOTES / OUT / LAYERS chip row with project tempo; the OUT panel shows all sixteen buses.
After install, restart REAPER. The Kit Bridge auto-registers on first run; run "EON: Install / Refresh Actions" any time to re-register the catalogue.
